summary: #569: document and enforce guidance architecture (persona remains thin summary; detailed protocols stay in agent_guidance.py + AGENTS; tests use key phrases/headers, not long verbatim strings) to eliminate byte-limit churn on future guidance additions. Add explicit note in guidance.
migration_impact: Downstream agent prompt surfaces following plate persona will see no behavior change (rules were already documented). Custom tests that pinned full guidance strings may need update to phrase checks.
migration_guidance: 1. If you maintain copies of plate.agent.md or guidance excerpts, keep them as summaries only.
2. Update any local tests of agent output to check for section names or key sentences rather than entire paragraphs.
agent_notes: When extending QUIET or QANDA guidance, add only to the .py module and AGENTS; update persona.md with a one-line reference if the new rule is a 'MUST' for routing. Tests will not break on wording tweaks inside the detailed guidance.
